Ajmodadi Churna (Powder of Apium graveolens ) – Ajmoda helps in relieving the painful conditions of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, gouty arthritis along with non specific arthritis.  Mix all the powdered ingredients in the equal amount of hot jaggery and make a thick paste, then make the appropriate tablets from the mixture and after drying preserve the tablets in a glass tumbler.

Moreover the ingredients are the part of deepniya and shoolhar mahaakshay mentioned by Acharya Charka, hence this combination in whole is useful in relieving various chronic painful conditions and also anti inflammatory and digestive stimulants.

fullContent:
Ajmodadi Vatak 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Aamvaatrogadhikar 605/121-124 
 Introduction 
 Ajmodadi vatak is a classical formulation made from multiple herbs. The constituent herbs of this formulation are having analgesic, anti-inflammatory, digestive stimulant etc. properties. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ajmodadi Churna – 46 gms 
 Pippali Churna – 46 gms 
 Maricha Churna – 46 gms 
 Vidanga Churna – 46 gms 
 Devdaru Churna – 46 gms 
 Chitrakmool Churna – 46 gms 
 Sounf Churna – 46 gms 
 Saindhav Churna – 46 gms 
 Haritaki Churna – 230 gm 
 Vidharamool Churna – 460gm 
 Shunthi Churna – 460 gm 
 Jaggery – 1570 gm 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Ajmodadi Churna (Powder of Apium graveolens ) – Ajmoda helps in relieving the painful conditions of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, gouty arthritis along with non specific arthritis. It also helps in treating the chronic pain due to gastritis, treating the condition of cough, asthma and bronchitis. 
 Maricha Churna (Powder of Piper nigrum ) – Maricha is frequently used in the treatment of hoarseness of voice, cough, cold, and various digestion related disorders. It is also having some blood purifying activities on regular use.  
 Piper Churna (Powder of Piper longum ) – This is the best herbal treatment for the kapaha related disorders which constitutes the respiratory tract ailments including COPD, cough, cold and congestion by removing phlegm deposits. It is also one of the best appetizer and digestive stimulants. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Mix all the powdered ingredients in the equal amount of hot jaggery and make a thick paste, then make the appropriate tablets from the mixture and after drying preserve the tablets in a glass tumbler. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Acharya had given the description of this formulation by saying that as all the darkness vanishes after sunrise likewise this Ajmodadi vatak treats the various diseases that are indicated. Most of the ingredients are having hot potency, and are very much beneficial in vata and kapha related conditions. Moreover the ingredients are the part of deepniya and shoolhar mahaakshay mentioned by Acharya Charka, hence this combination in whole is useful in relieving various chronic painful conditions and also anti inflammatory and digestive stimulants. 
 Indications 
 
 Vata roga (Neurological and movement related disorders) 
 Kushtroga (Skin disorders) 
 Visuchika (Cholera) 
 Hridroga (Heart disorders) 
 Ugra gridhransi (Chronic and severe sciatica) 
 Katipeeda (Backache) 
 Gudpeeda (Pain in rectum) 
 Vastisfutna (Pain in bladder) 
 Asthipeeda (Pain in bones) 
 Jangha-peeda (Pain in legs) 
 Shotha (Inflammatory conditions) 
 Sandhishotha (Inflammation in joints) 
 Amavaat (Rheumatoid arthritis) 
 
 Dosage 
 2 tablets twice daily with warm water, (10 gram maximum). 
 Contraindications 
 To be avoided in bhasmak roga (excessive hunger) and heartburn conditions. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
